topic: MP3 encoder delay: how many samples does the start carry, and does `-c copy` keep it gapless?
why: Every MP3 starts with silence from the encoder and a decoder delay. Trims, joins and loops land late unless the delay is known. Style: Technical mini-documentary, specimen plate of the first frames with the Xing and LAME header bytes circled.

topic: Opus pre-skip: does the file start 312 samples late, and what does `-ss` do to it?
why: The Ogg header asks the decoder to drop samples before the audio. Players and `-c copy` cuts treat it differently. Style: Fireship fast code, one counter, hard cuts.

topic: GIF to MP4: GIF delays are in hundredths of a second, so what frame rate comes out?
why: A 3 cs delay is 33.3 fps, not 30. Speed and length shift after conversion. Style: Illustrated scenario, a reel and a clock, then the measured proof.

topic: `select='gt(scene,0.4)'`: what is a scene score, and what does a cut, a fade and noise score?
why: People pick 0.3 or 0.4 by folklore. Measure the score of known cuts, fades and noisy flat frames. Style: Vox flat graphics, bars drawn to scale.

topic: `blackdetect`: what do `pix_th` and `pic_th` really mean on a fade to black?
why: Two thresholds and a duration decide when black starts. Measure start and end against a known fade. Style: Cinematic screen demo, terminal with the matching lines pinned.

topic: `silencedetect n=-50dB` or `n=0.001`: which units, and how exact are the timestamps?
why: Same threshold, two spellings, and a start time that can sit a block late. Test tones with gaps of known length. Style: Fireship fast code.

topic: Where does the spectrum end: AAC, MP3 and Opus lowpass at each bitrate
why: Encoders cut the top of the spectrum by bitrate. Sweep a tone and read where it disappears. Style: Technical mini-documentary, spectrum plates.

topic: 10 bit to 8 bit: why does a smooth gradient band, and does dither fix it?
why: `format=yuv420p` truncates or rounds; scaler dither changes the steps. Count distinct levels on a ramp. Style: Editorial collage, torn strips of the ramp.

topic: `overlay` at an odd x or y in yuv420p: where does the picture really land?
why: Chroma is half resolution, so an odd offset can shift color by a pixel. Marker card, read both planes. Style: Physical 3D cutaway, luma and chroma slabs.

topic: `vstack` and `hstack` with different sizes: what error, and what do `scale2ref` and `shortest` change?
why: The filter refuses mismatched widths; the fixes change length and size in ways nobody checks. Style: Johnny Harris desk-and-map, cards pinned on a board.

topic: `chromakey` or `colorkey`: what does similarity mean, and how many edge pixels survive?
why: Both take similarity and blend with different color spaces. Known green card with a soft edge, count alpha levels. Style: Vox flat graphics.

topic: Transparent video: which formats keep alpha, and what does `yuv420p` do to it?
why: PNG to MP4 flattens to black; ProRes 4444, VP9 and PNG keep alpha. Decode and read alpha. Style: Illustrated scenario, checkerboard and a cutout.

topic: `-copyts` with `-ss`: what start time does the output keep?
why: The flag keeps source timestamps, and the output starts late or negative. Compare start_time on mp4, mkv and ts. Style: Johnny Harris desk-and-map, string between timestamps.

topic: `-f segment -c copy`: why are my segments not the length I asked for?
why: Copy can only cut on keyframes, and `reset_timestamps` changes what players show. Measure each segment. Style: Cinematic screen demo, file tree filling up.

topic: Does `-g 250` still add keyframes on hard cuts, and what does `-sc_threshold 0` change?
why: Scene cut detection inserts extra keyframes. Count I-frames on a clip with known cuts. Style: Fireship fast code.

topic: `pts`, `dts` and `best_effort_timestamp`: which one is the time of this frame?
why: With B-frames the three differ. Read all of them for a known clip and show which tool prints which. Style: Technical mini-documentary, exploded timeline.

topic: Resampling 48 kHz to 44.1 kHz: exact sample count, and does the length change?
why: `aresample` rounds the output length by a few samples, which adds up in joins. Known tone, count samples. Style: Vox flat graphics.

topic: `afade` curves: how loud is the middle of a fade for tri, qsin, exp and log?
why: The curve names say nothing about how loud the midpoint is. Measure gain at 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent. Style: Editorial collage, cut-out curves.

topic: `dynaudnorm` or `loudnorm`: which one changes the loudness range, and by how much?
why: Both are sold as normalizers; one levels, one targets. Measure integrated loudness and range on a synthetic program. Style: Illustrated scenario, a speaker and a dial.

topic: WAV piped out of ffmpeg: why does the header say the file is 4 GB, or 0 bytes?
why: A pipe cannot seek back to fix the header. Read the RIFF and data sizes and what players make of them. Style: Technical mini-documentary, hex plate.
